ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the recent surge in Medicaid fraud cases in Minnesota, exploring the methods used by scammers and the impact on the state's healthcare system
questions: What methods are being used to commit Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How much has Medicaid fraud cost the state in recent years?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose widespread fraud and corruption, highlighting the need for increased oversight and accountability within the state's healthcare system.
